comment: Checks `gates:coverage:check` may find unwired without failing (ADR 0043). Every entry names a checker — by `check-*.mjs` filename or by the package.json script that runs it — and carries a written reason. An entry without a reason is rejected, and so is one naming something that no longer exists: an exemption is a decision somebody made, not a gap nobody saw.

optOut.reason: Superseded by the pre-commit hook's `format:write --uncommitted`, which rewrites formatting and restages it instead of failing on it. Wiring the read-only twin would fail commits the hook has already fixed.

Not a gate. It reports sub-agent model assignments against the published model catalogs and opens a drift issue on a monthly schedule; it asserts nothing about the commit in front of it, and a catalog moving under us is not a reason to fail somebody's unrelated change.
Not a gate. It benchmarks graphify project-edge extraction and reports timings, so it has no fact to fail on and no threshold a commit could cross. Run it by hand when tuning extraction.
